dialogues.speaker: Furong
dialogues.text: I'm talking about the crow's nest. No clue if Liushi's found anything.

dialogues.speaker: Furong
dialogues.text: I've hollered for him a few times, but no dice. Maybe the waves are too loud, and he can't hear me.

dialogues.speaker: Furong
dialogues.text: I'm a little afraid of heights, so I, uh... Ahem. Why don't you have a look if you have the time, eh?
